title: What Optical Interconnect Fabrics Is
definition: Optical Interconnect Fabrics: light-based wiring inside computers.
description:
Optical Interconnect Fabrics: light-based wiring inside computers. This is Future Computing Paradigms at its most ambitious — waveguide meshes research, fabric logistics engineering and laser integration operations converging on a single goal: making fabric hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Computing Paradigms will decide packaging outcomes this century. Optical Interconnect Fabrics is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working fabric hulls, the larger waveguide meshes vision stalls, and with it, the fabric logistics systems that depend on it.

This database documents Optical Interconnect Fabrics in full: what it is, the real research behind it today, the pieces it is built from, dated forecasts, runnable demo programs, and a teaching ladder from foundations to mastery. Every record carries a working program you can run.

title: Real Research Today: Optical Interconnect Fabrics
definition: Today's documented research behind Optical Interconnect Fabrics.
description:
The road to Optical Interconnect Fabrics is already being paved. Google's Sycamore and Willow chips demonstrated quantum error-correction milestones. DNA data storage (Microsoft/University of Washington) encodes digital data in synthetic DNA.

Lightmatter and Luminous Computing build photonic AI accelerators. Together these programs form the waveguide meshes foundation that Optical Interconnect Fabrics will build on — the fabric logistics results, the laser integration methods, and the institutional memory.

Forecasts are projections, not promises: the dated milestones in this database reflect published roadmaps and expert surveys, and they will move as fabric logistics research advances. Treat every date as a planning scenario with error bars, and watch the signals listed in each milestone record.

title: Readiness Estimator: Optical Interconnect Fabrics
definition: Estimates Optical Interconnect Fabrics readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Optical Interconnect Fabrics components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a fabric hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Optical Interconnect Fabrics Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Optical Interconnect Fabrics: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Optical Interconnect Fabrics — light-based wiring inside computers.

Phase 1 — Prove (waveguide meshes): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fabric logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (laser integration): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (packaging): fabric hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and datacenters-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
